name: chain-demotion
sourceTreeHashMethod: sorted nested git tracked plus untracked source file paths; hash path UTF-8, NUL, then SHA256 file bytes for each existing file; final SHA256

treatmentBit.name: replayPrefix
treatmentBit.share: The existing salted half of replay slots, approximately one quarter of non-probe grid runs; unchanged assignment and empty-slot behavior.
treatmentBit.control: The existing replay-slot runs without replayPrefix, which reuse a parent's configuration and workload and run a fresh schedule. Non-slot runs and AOS receive no new policy.
treatmentBit.identity: The bit continues to mean schedule-prefix replay from a corpus parent. No new bit, nested run-id dose, campaign arm, or protected registration edit. This is a replacement of the prefix-replay search mechanism, not a reinterpretation of a selector or fault bit.
treatmentBit.contrast: Intention to treat on all prefix-tagged slots, including unfilled and failed branch attempts, probe-free and matched on existing co-bits. Also compute the candidate prefix/plan-only ratio divided by the paired baseline prefix/plan-only ratio. A filled-only ratio is descriptive, never the treatment estimate.
treatmentBit.inverse: No additional inverse cell: alternatives and initial chain orders are sampled symmetrically, and neither search procedure has a single protocol-independent signed inverse. They are stochastic policies inside the one existing prefix-replay mechanism, not hidden run-id treatment doses.

frozenPrediction.mechanism: The probe-free, co-bit-matched prefix/plan-only per-run ratio will be1.20-1.60; its ratio to the paired baseline contrast will be1.15-1.50. Fixed four-grid-arm primary events/sec>=1.06 baseline, whole-campaign events/sec>=1.03 baseline, and AOS depth8 per run>=0.95 baseline. These are separate predictions, not estimates inferred by dividing grid utility by whole-campaign throughput.
frozenPrediction.independentObservable: Per300-second chunk, >=40000 prefix children activate before their own cap, >=25000 active children execute >=8 subsequent steps, and >=15000 active children reach at least one change point. At least20% of eligible suffix tournament decisions have >=2 distinct chains in the candidates actually sampled. On those multi-chain sampled contests the final legal winner differs from the shadow stock winner at least15% of the time; fresh-first/pair-order overwrites and same-chain ties are separate counts. Among active children with at least eight suffix dispatches, median consecutive executable dispatches sharing one chain rises at least25% over plan-only children measured after their own first signal, while realized timer dispatch share stays within10% relative of that control. The latter comparison is descriptive and reports readiness/arm strata; the randomized all-slot contrast decides utility. Emit activation delay from tape exhaustion, frozen remaining-cap bins, excluded selector type, change points reached, distinct chains sampled, inherited cross-node sends, same-chain ties, shadow-choice changes before and after merged preferences, and per-arm chain-run-length histograms. Existing counters cannot currently report these quantities; all are added with the mechanism.
frozenPrediction.falsifier: Refuted if the matched treatment contrast interval lies wholly below1.20 or its paired baseline-adjusted contrast lies wholly below1.15. Supply below40000 active runs, below15000 reached change points, multi-chain contest share below20%, final dispatch authority below15%, or chain persistence growth below25% refutes the claimed mechanism. A timer-share change above10% requires closing this specification because preserving timer admission in code did not preserve the claimed exposure. Primary<=baseline with more coherent chains is not success. Repeated AOS ratio below0.95 or whole-campaign utility loss prevents merge despite a grid gain. Report replay-family sensitivity rather than treating sibling runs as independent evidence.
frozenPrediction.costClause: Cross-binary whole-campaign throughput>=0.97 of paired baseline. The original cap, completed-plan termination and number of histories are unchanged. Do not skip baseline priority samples to claim a speedup: byte-consumption parity is part of the mechanism. All trace and client-history semantics remain ordinary. If supply or dispatch authority fails in the first normal chunk, close before additional chunks/panel. Additional ancestry storage is at most one u64 chain id per executable or buffered executable object, with measured Rust layout growth at most16 bytes per affected Record/ChannelSend/partition-buffered message representation. Run-local chain control and observation storage is at most1024 bytes, excluding existing state and the one chain id per object; use fixed-size counters/histograms. Retain at most two demoted chain ids and derive other chain priorities directly from seed/id, with no dynamically growing per-chain map, ancestry graph or per-step log. Export the relevant size_of layout measurements, maximum run-local allocated bytes, maximum retained demotion entries and count of root allocations; verify fixed bounds against the ordinary trial. Peak process RSS may be reported descriptively but has no paired ratio gate.
frozenPrediction.measurementClarification: The20% multi-chain sampled contest share uses all eligible suffix tournament decisions. The15% final choice-change fraction is restricted to multi-chain samples with an executable stock winner, as frozen by the mixed-fault rule; report both denominators and exclusions. New chain metadata and all control histograms must be explicitly implemented. This is a prefix-replay-plus-causal-chain replacement policy contrast versus plan-only, not a randomized estimate of chain ranking alone. Raw1.20-1.60 and paired baseline-adjusted1.15-1.50 remain separate bands; use the existing grader without registration or protocol changes.
frozenPrediction.memoryMeasurementClarification: Pre-admission memory correction: the current same-identity baseline cache contains no RSS/resident/peak-memory fields and no matching baseline peak is available in retained observations. A valid paired peak would require additional baseline acquisition, not reinterpretation of a cached metric. No new baseline run, calibration-only round, identity change or cache mutation is authorized by this proposal. The unsupported peak-RSS ratio is therefore removed before admission and replaced by directly checkable bounds on additional mechanism-owned storage. These bounds constrain bookkeeping/corpus growth; they are NOT a claim that total process RSS is unchanged or below the original1.25x/1.15x thresholds. Actual process peak, if collected during the ordinary candidate chunk, is descriptive only.

smoke.purpose: firing only; no performance, supply, utility or linearizability inference
smoke.command: spur/target/release/spur explore -e campaign --config scheduler_configs/loop/general_vr.json --set campaign.wall_budget_sec=1 --output-dir MAIN/tmp/loop/lite/chain-demotion/smoke -y bin/spur/VR.spur
smoke.finalDiagnosticAddition: After this single smoke, added only the explicit zero/one/two_or_more sampled-chain count histogram. No scheduling change. Final full tests and release build include it; no second smoke.

ownedStorage.layoutMethod: compiled tests with exact untagged baseline field and variant mirrors; no baseline performance run

interpretations: Freeze actual effective_cap from path.rs; >=3 remaining total steps permits two future points in current+1..cap-1.
Activate at the first step boundary after source exhaustion and own signal; source exhaustion step is noted at the end of the consuming step.
Timer firing creates a root assigned to an actually resumed reader. Buffered timer unit consumed later by an already running record does not transfer ancestry.
Inline executed recovery Record sets last executed chain for demotion; the enclosing fault still breaks the dispatch histogram stretch.
Histograms qualify runs using >=8 selected suffix dispatches; active_eight_steps remains a separate scheduling-step counter.
Exact run lengths1..31; bucket32 is >=32. Censored final stretches are included once and also exported separately.
Readiness stratum is bit0 timer eligible, bit1 network eligible; streak stratum is read at its first dispatch.
Export super.patch with --ignore-submodules=dirty because all subject edits are in the nested Spur worktree.
untrackedMirror: untracked/ (files also included in complete spur.patch)

diagnostics.sampledDistinctChains: exact bins zero,one,two_or_more; the frozen >=2 denominator is not approximated
diagnostics.planOnlyCut: first child-owned signal, observed at following step boundary
diagnostics.prefixCut: activation boundary after exhausted source and own signal
